log.system: Thank you for your patient waiting. Hello, there are two types of 5G networks: SA (Standalone Access) and NSA (Non-Standalone Access). When your phone shows the 5G network sign, it only means that you have connected to the 5G network. However, it doesn't necessarily mean you are using SA. Only when your phone supports and has activated SA, and the network in your current location also supports SA, then you will use SA for internet access. The data volume used in this scenario will be counted into the 5G-specific data package. If your phone hasn't activated SA and is using the NSA to access the 5G network, the data volume will not be counted in the 5G-specific data package and it will be charged according to your other data plans.
